brief: A riverside market under striped awnings: baskets of fruit, heaps of red and yellow spice, swinging brass scales; a small saffron-yellow spirit darting between stalls pointing at things, a round cheerful spice seller watching him, you, Dādī and Śuka among the shoppers.
